description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee membership search parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to manage employee number filtering and sorting options.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters when searching for employee memberships, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
